title: Trace the Loop
subject: computer science
instructions: Trace the code by hand. Write your ID number, not your name.

questions.title: Program A

questions.prompt: Trace It: Fill in the value of total after each pass through the loop in Program A.
Predict: What does line 7 print, and why?
questions.key: It prints 4: total ends at 4 after the last pass (n = 4 adds 4 to 0). Full credit needs 4 and a reason tied to the trace; 4 alone is partial.

questions.prompt: Fix It: Complete Program B so it adds up only the odd numbers from 1 to 9.
What does Program B print once it's fixed?

options.why: That adds every number from 1 to 9.
That's the last odd number, not the sum.
